d: Short, sleek burgundy hair with a side parting and straight bangs framing the face. Narrow, sharp reddish-pink eyes behind silver-rimmed glasses on a mature, youthful face. A slender build dressed in a white high-waisted suit with a matching white vest and trousers, layered under a long burnt-orange overcoat with a dark green dress shirt and a red tie. Black gloves hold a dark blue folder with white inverted text. BODY COLOR: pale LEGS: plantigrade, wearing black pointed dress shoes.
